scenarios.title: Festival Tourist Express
scenarios.question: Why is the Passenger Train the best choice for moving all 500 tourists to the festival within the limits?
scenarios.answer: It moves everyone in a single trip while staying under budget and time limits.

scenarios.title: Building Lumber Supply
scenarios.question: Why does the Freight Train succeed at delivering 2,000 tons of lumber?
scenarios.answer: Its massive capacity carries the entire load in a single trip within budget and emissions limits.

scenarios.title: Suburban Commuter Rush
scenarios.question: How does the Intercity Train efficiently handle 1,200 commuters?
scenarios.answer: It uses only 2 trips while staying well within the cost and time limits.

scenarios.title: Suburban School Trip to the Science Museum
scenarios.route: 🏫 Greenwood Elementary School -> 🏬 City Science Museum (15 km)
scenarios.question: Why is taking the School Buses the best choice to stay under our $600 budget?
scenarios.answer: They have the largest capacity, meaning we only need 2 trips for 95 people, keeping total cost at $500.

scenarios.title: Uptown Academy Excursion
scenarios.route: 🏫 Oakridge Middle School -> 🏬 National History Museum (25 km)
scenarios.question: Which option keeps our total expense below the $800 limit while moving all 140 students?
scenarios.answer: Large Coach Buses, because 3 trips cost $750, whereas cars and vans cost over $1,000.

scenarios.title: West End Field Trip
scenarios.route: 🏫 Pinecrest Primary -> 🏬 Art and Culture Museum (10 km)
scenarios.question: Why is the Shuttle Bus a smart choice for keeping within the $300 budget for this smaller group?
scenarios.answer: It requires only 1 trip carrying all 45 passengers for $220, which is less than $300.
